## About

I am a postdoctoral researcher in the [Laboratory for Waste Management (LES)](https://www.psi.ch/en/les) at the [Paul Scherrer Institute](https://www.psi.ch/en), Switzerland. My work brings together thermodynamic modelling, reactive-transport simulation and machine learning to design low-carbon cementitious materials and to understand how cement-based barriers evolve in radioactive-waste repositories.

I obtained my Ph.D. from Politecnico di Milano, where I studied the self-healing and long-term durability of ultra-high performance concrete. Before that, I trained in civil engineering at Shenzhen University and Yunnan Agricultural University.
